entries.b40f38e18138b356: This business sells household electrical appliances and other products, and is the company's only reportable segment. As of the end of August 2025, it operated 139 stores, with the main store name being Kojima×BIC CAMERA. The company has jointly purchased merchandise with its parent company, [[company:bic-camera|BIC CAMERA INC.]], since October 2013. Revenue for the company as a whole for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥282,790 million. In addition, in October 2025 the company opened a new store in Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture.
